# RyperDeck

> Turn your phone or tablet into an ultra-fluid liquid glass wireless macro deck for Windows. 100% free, zero latency, limitless pages, and zero hardware required.

## Overview
RyperDeck is an open, modern, and free alternative to expensive physical macro hardware like the Elgato Stream Deck ($150-$250). Created by solo 20-year-old developer Anurag, RyperDeck connects your Android phone or tablet to your Windows 10/11 PC over local Wi-Fi via UDP multipeer protocol, offering sub-millisecond tap response without any cloud relay or telemetry.

## Key Features & Capabilities
- **100% Free Forever**: No subscriptions, no ads, no paywalls, no device limits.
- **Limitless Pages & Matrix Grids**: Unlike physical 8 or 15-key decks, RyperDeck supports unlimited custom pages (Media, Gaming, Workflows, PC Hardware Monitoring, Streaming).
- **Remote Keyboard & Precision Trackpad Hub**: Doubles as a complete wireless PC input device with a multi-touch trackpad, physical click buttons, two-finger gesture scrolling, and full remote keyboard.
- **Zero Latency UDP Socket Protocol**: Direct low-latency socket packet transmission over your local Wi-Fi network (< 1ms latency).
- **100% Private by Design**: Keystrokes, macros, and layouts never leave your local Wi-Fi router. Zero account creation, zero cloud relays, zero telemetry.
- **Windows System Tray Companion**: Runs as a lightweight native portable executable on Windows 11 & 10 consuming under 15MB of RAM.
- **Audio & Media Control**: Per-app Windows volume mixer dials and hotkeys.
- **OBS Studio & Streaming**: Native macro triggers for scenes, mic mute, push-to-talk, and recording.
- **Custom .JSON Preset Engine**: Export and import full workspace layouts or individual pages with 1-click .json files.

## Platforms & Requirements
- **Windows**: Windows 11 and Windows 10 (64-bit). Portable executable: `RyperDeckAgent.exe`
- **Mobile**: Android phones and tablets (Android 8.0 to Android 15+). Package: `RyperDeck.apk`
- **Connectivity**: Local Wi-Fi router (no internet required) or USB cable.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- **Is RyperDeck truly 100% free?** Yes, completely free forever with zero ads or subscriptions.
- **Does it require an internet connection?** No, it communicates purely over local network UDP broadcast.
- **Can I run it on an old phone or tablet?** Yes, place any spare Android smartphone or tablet beside your keyboard and it will auto-reconnect on PC boot.
- **Is it secure?** Yes, 100% offline. No servers, no accounts, no telemetry.
